correctness.rationale: If four unit complex numbers sum to zero they split into antipodal pairs. At a nonzero even frequency the character has odd order dividing p, so antipodes are unavailable and no zero occurs. At k=p the sum is the parity difference and vanishes exactly for two even and two odd residues. For odd k≠p, k is a unit modulo 2p; an antipodal pairing of character values forces the paired exponents to differ by p, so A is a union of two antipodal pairs. Conversely such pairs cancel at every odd frequency. The three zero sets therefore have cardinalities p,1,0, and elementary counting gives C(p,2), C(p,2)^2-C(p,2), and C(2p,4)-C(p,2)^2. The exact cyclotomic verifier exhausts representative primes, and an independent replay for small odd primes reproduced the classification; the universal proof is analytic.

final_claim: For every odd prime p and every four-element A⊂Z_{2p}, the indicator Fourier-support size is exactly p, 2p-1, or 2p: p exactly for unions of two antipodal pairs, 2p-1 exactly for parity-balanced non-antipodal sets, and 2p otherwise, with the stated closed counts of all three strata.
